source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

items.name: Cold Adaptation
items.text: The arabuk reduces the effects it suffers from cold environments by one step.

items.name: Snow Vision
items.text: Snow doesn't impair an arabuk's vision; it ignores Concealment from snowfall.

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The arabuk Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the arabuk began this action Hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

items.name: Reverb
items.text:
Trigger The arabuk hits a creature with an antler Strike

---

Effect The arabuk snarls, causing its antlers to reverberate and dealing an additional 1d4 sonic damage to the creature struck. This is in addition to the normal sonic damage from the antler Strike.

items.name: Snow Stride
items.text: The arabuk ignores difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, and uneven ground from non-magical ice and snow.
